content_sections.heading: CAU Imphal Computer Operator Vacancy 2026 Notification PDF
content_sections.text: Candidates who are interested in applying for the CAU Imphal Recruitment 2026 should first download and carefully read the official notification PDF. The notification contains complete details about vacancy distribution, eligibility criteria, age limit, stipend/salary, selection process, important dates, and application instructions. Reading the official document is important to ensure that you meet all requirements before submitting the application form. Download CAU Imphal Computer Operator Job 2026 Notification PDF

content_sections.heading: Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Computer Operator: Bachelor's Degree in Computer Application/ Information Technology/ Computer Science from a recognized University/ Institution. Desirable: Candidate having at least one year of experience in Software Design and Development, along with knowledge of Hardware and Networking.

content_sections.heading: Age Limit
content_sections.text: Maximum Age Limit: 35 years. For SC/ST/OBC candidates, the age limit is as per the Govt. of India norms. Candidates are advised to check whether they satisfy the prescribed age limit before applying. Use our online Age Calculator to calculate your exact age instantly.

content_sections.heading: Walk-In Procedure
content_sections.text: Read the official notification carefully before attending the interview. Candidates must report at the venue as per the reporting time mentioned in the notification. Carry all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies such as ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if required), and category certificate (if applicable). Bring the duly filled application form if required in the notification. Verify eligibility criteria before attending the interview. Candidates are advised to reach the venue well in advance to complete registration formalities. Keep extra passport-size photographs for submission if required.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to attend the walk-in interview for the Computer Operator post?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview for the Computer Operator post at Central Agricultural University Imphal is scheduled for 18th September 2026. Candidates should ensure they report to the venue on this date.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for the Computer Operator position?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a Bachelor's Degree in Computer Application, Information Technology, or Computer Science from a recognized University or Institution to be eligible for the Computer Operator role.

faq.question: Q3. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment drive conducted by Central Agricultural University Imphal.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for the Computer Operator post?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for the Computer Operator post is 35 years. Age relaxation for SC/ST/OBC candidates will be as per the Government of India norms.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary offered for the Computer Operator position?
faq.answer: The selected candidate for the Computer Operator post will receive a fixed salary of Rs. 35,400/- per month.

faq.question: Q6. How many vacancies are available for the Computer Operator post?
faq.answer: There is one vacancy available for the Computer Operator post in this recruitment drive by Central Agricultural University Imphal.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for the Computer Operator role?
faq.answer: The selection process for the Computer Operator position will be based on a Walk-in Interview. Candidates need to attend the interview directly.

faq.question: Q8. Where is the walk-in interview for CAU Imphal Recruitment 2026 going to be held?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview will be held at the Central Agricultural University Imphal campus in Jalukie, Nagaland, with the pincode 797110.

faq.question: Q9. What documents should I carry for the walk-in interview?
faq.answer: Candidates should carry all original documents, one set of self-attested photocopies (ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates if any), and category certificates if applicable.

faq.question: Q10. Is there any preference for candidates with experience?
faq.answer: Yes, candidates having at least one year of experience in Software Design and Development, along with knowledge of Hardware and Networking, are considered desirable for the Computer Operator post.
